csv_project_name: CMAR Svc for RFCC & WARC Renovations
csv_scope_of_work: The Williston Parks & Recreation District (WPRD), a North Dakota political subdivision, is soliciting proposals from qualified firms to provide Construction Manager at Risk (CMaR) services for the Raymond Family Community Center (RFCC) and Williston Area Recreation Center (WARC) renovation projects. The selected CMaR will provide preconstruction guidance and construction services for a public recreation facility renovation program that includes major existing-building renovation, operational reconfiguration, exterior envelope work, site/access improvements, and selected WARC interior renovations. This procurement is conducted under North Dakota Century Code (NDCC) Chapter 48-01.2, including the provisions applicable to public improvements and Construction Manager at Risk delivery. The selected CMaR must comply with all applicable North Dakota public bidding, contractor licensing, bonding, insurance, civil rights, accessibility, safety, and public construction requirements. WPRD intends to solicit this RFP through the Quest database / QuestCDN or successor Quest platform. The official solicitation record, plan-holder registration, posted documents, written questions, addenda, and electronic submittal process will be administered through Quest unless WPRD issues written alternate instructions by addendum. The selected CMaR will work collaboratively with WPRD, JLG Architects and associated consultants, applicable City of Williston departments and review authorities, WPRD facility operations staff, user groups, and subcontractors/suppliers selected through the applicable public procurement process.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering
